title: Quick German Pretzel Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make German-inspired wrap filled with soft pretzel dough, savory cheese, and juicy ham.
instructions: Roll out the pretzel dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Meanwhile, cook the ham slices in a pan over medium heat until lightly browned.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the Swiss cheese on the pretzel dough, followed by the cooked ham.
Roll up the wrap tightly and serve warm.
